# Lusha

B2B contact enrichment and prospecting platform providing verified email addresses, phone numbers, and company information

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/lusha/.

## Actions

- **Create Subscription**: Create one or more webhook subscriptions for real-time signal notifications.
- **List Subscriptions** (read-only): List all webhook subscriptions for your account with pagination support.
- **Update Subscription**: Update an existing webhook subscription configuration.
- **Delete Subscriptions**: Delete one or more webhook subscriptions by their IDs.
- **Get Audit Log Stats** (read-only): Retrieve aggregated statistics for audit logs.
- **Get Audit Logs** (read-only): Retrieve audit logs for your account including API calls and webhook deliveries.
- **Get Subscription** (read-only): Get details of a specific webhook subscription by ID.
